_comment: Project-level config for this repo's own validators - the same .ai-sdlc.json that tools/framework-setup.py generates for consumer projects.

logging._comment: research/poker-capstone/{runs,broken-variants} hold ASSESSMENT ARTEFACTS, not application code we maintain, so the 10 mandatory logging points do not apply. runs/ is VERBATIM output from the model under test, some defective on purpose as a recorded result (runs/haiku-p5-* is the implementation whose bug we graded as that model's P5 FAIL) and must stay byte-identical so a score can be re-verified. broken-variants/ is exemplar copies each carrying one deliberately-injected bug, proving the harness fails on the SPECIFIC defect. Without this, ~50k lines of model output tip the checker's framework-vs-application auto-detection and the WHOLE repo gets held to application logging rules. The assessment harness and the exemplar are our own code and are NOT skipped.
